statement: ∀ m k : Nat, (Int.subNatNat m k).natAbs ≤ m + k
tactic: intro m k unfold Int.subNatNat cases hk : k - m with | zero => exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.sub_le m k) (Nat.le_add_right m k) | succ j => show j + 1 ≤ m + k have hj : j + 1 ≤ k := hk ▸ Nat.sub_le k m exact Nat.le_trans hj (Nat.le_add_left k m)
